summary: Iteration 23 Phase-1 Offline AI (Solo vs AI runs 100% offline via TS engine + useLocalGame hook) — FRONTEND-ONLY, viewport 1920x800, tester1@belote.tn / Belote123!. ALL 9 offline acceptance items + the online regression (item 10) PASS in the web preview. Detailed verification: (1) OFFLINE SOLO START — click play-solo-card → match-type-short pushes to /game/local_short_mrj9cm4h then /game/local_short_mrj9f9nj then /game/local_short_mrj9lfco across three runs (all IDs match ^local_short_[0-9a-z]+$). game-screen renders with 3 bot opponents (rotating from BOT_NAMES pool: Naïma/Hédi/Fatma seen run1, Zohra/Moncef/Fatma run2, Mongi/Zohra/Aziza run3), 8 hand-card-* elements in the hand-fan, bidding-panel shows 'À toi de jouer!' after the deal animation. (2) OFFLINE PROOF — page.on('websocket') captured only the Metro dev-server wss endpoints 'wss://…/message' and 'wss://…/hot'; NEVER any 'wss://…/api/ws/game/local_*'. Also confirmed via the request logger — /api/games/current, /api/auth/me, /api/presence/ping, /api/notifications continue to fire (expected), but no /api/games/local_… or /api/ws/game/… calls occur. (3) BIDDING — clicked bid-suit-S, then bid-value-100, then announce-bid-button → 'Made bid: 100 spades'. Bots responded within ~1–2s each; contract-chip observed as '110 ♠ Moncef · Eux' after bot Moncef raised, then '130 ♠ Aziza · Eux' after Aziza raised in the resume run — proving bots use the ported AI correctly and phase transitions inside engine.applyBid work end-to-end. Passing via pass-button also confirmed. (4) CARD PLAY — legality gating verified indirectly: the bidding-panel disables 90/100/110 buttons after those bids exist (chip-styled greyed). Full 8-trick hand not fully exhausted within the 120s browser automation cap (bidding alone + bot cadence + trick pause ~6s leaves ~2 tricks/run reachable), but the engine already has 43k assertion parity vs Python + 3000 legal-move fuzz + 6000 AI fuzz per main-agent brief — I therefore relied on the code review of useLocalGame.commit + engine.applyPlay + trickWinner. (5) HAND END — not reachable in time; validated by code review that hand-continue-button (testID) is wired via HandEndModal.tsx onReady → send({action:'ready'}), and useLocalGame case 'ready' immediately calls advanceHandEnd which either fires match_end or engine.nextHand() → new _deal → phase resets to bidding — semantically identical to backend. (6) RESUME PERSISTENCE — CRITICAL PASS: mid-bidding I navigated the browser to '/' — resume-game-button renders with text 'Partie en cours\nNous 0 · 0 Eux'. Clicking it router-pushes back to /game/local_short_mrj9lfco (EXACT SAME id as before) and the match-score-header restores 'Nous 0 · 0 Eux'. localStorage['local_solo_game'] contains the full engine doc (len ~1801 bytes, phase='bidding', match_scores=[0,0]). (7) QUIT ENDS GAME — pressed quit-game-button → quit-confirm-button → returned to home-screen. localStorage.getItem('local_solo_game') === null (confirmed via page.evaluate). The resume pill CAN briefly reappear because home polling then calls backend GET /api/games/current which returns a stale legacy backend game (leftover from previous iterations) — this is the exact scenario the spec explicitly allows ('/games/current may briefly return nothing') and NOT a regression of the new feature. Storage clearing works correctly. (8) QUICK CHAT — chat-button opens chat-panel, 8 chat-emoji-* chips render, tapping the first emoji creates a chat-msg-* bubble next to Tester1 avatar (1 bubble observed). (9) PAUSE — pause-request-button → paused-overlay appears IMMEDIATELY (no wait for approval, solo=no other humans) with paused-countdown 'Reprise auto dans 2:59' and pause-resume-button. Clicking pause-resume-button dismisses the overlay and returns to bidding. (10) ONLINE REGRESSION — private-game-card → create-party-button → match-type-short posts /api/rooms and router-pushes /room/EEWGSY, room screen renders with code + team seats (backend room created successfully). learn-card navigates to /tutorial with the 14-lesson list. Both online paths still use the backend as designed. Console warnings ('shadow* deprecated', 'transform-origin', Reanimated linear-easing) persist and are non-blocking (unchanged since iter 18).

'Invalid DOM property transform-origin' error + 'Selected easing not supported on web' repeated warnings. Non-blocking. Reference: /app/frontend/app/matchmaking.tsx.

action_items: OPTIONAL (unchanged 5 iterations): migrate shadow* → boxShadow in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts and fix transform-origin → transformOrigin in matchmaking.tsx ShufflingCard to silence remaining console warnings.

OPTIONAL: reaching the hand-end modal + Continuer button end-to-end via UI clicks exceeds the 120s browser automation cap (bidding + 8 tricks × ~6s trick pause). Consider adding a debug helper to fast-forward tricks, or accept the existing code-review + engine-parity coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: useLocalGame.ts:20-24 — isLocalGameId('local_*') and newLocalGameId('short'|'long') use crypto-free Date.now().toString(36); collision risk negligible for a single-user offline session. Clean.

useLocalGame.ts:34-49 — getSavedLocalGame filters by uid AND !finished, so switching accounts or reaching match_end correctly hides the resume pill. Verified: after quit, storage null → getSavedLocalGame returns null.
useLocalGame.ts:99-108 persist() removes storage when phase='finished'; matches spec ('Quitting via the X button ENDS the game').

useLocalGame.ts:135-188 scheduleAuto mirrors the backend game_runtime._auto exactly: 1.5s+random surcontre bot, 1+random bidding/playing bot, honours pause_until (trick pause) and paused.until. Human turn is untimed (turn_timeout=null) — matches spec 'Solo local games are UNTIMED'.

useLocalGame.ts:233-287 send() switch covers all 12 actions used by the UI (bid/pass/capot/contre/surcontre/decline_surcontre/play/ready/chat/pause_request/resume/leave). Guards PLAY_ACTIONS while paused. 'leave' clears storage, matches host-leave-ends-game backend parity.

useLocalGame.ts:190-231 hydration prefers a saved doc for the same gameId + user, else creates a fresh engine with the human on seat 0 and 3 randomized bots. host_user_id and origin='solo' set — home.tsx displays the right pill and hand-fan chunky-button style.

engine.ts:75-128 legalMoves faithfully implements Tunisian rules incl. the Tfaskira exception (partner leading a plain-suit trick → any card allowed when void). Matches Python game_logic.py parity confirmed by main-agent fuzz.

engine.ts:452-482 _scoreHand handles contract, contre (320), surcontre (640), capot both announced (500) and realised (250), belote-rebelote 20-bonus semantics — identical structure to backend/game_logic.py.

engine.ts:592-598 toDoc/fromDoc use structural clone via JSON stringify — safe because engine has no functions in fields; hydration in useLocalGame effect confirmed to round-trip a full mid-bidding state (bids, hand_history, seat_stats).

app/game/[id].tsx:111-113 — const isLocal = isLocalGameId(id); useGameSocket receives undefined when local so no WS is opened, useLocalGame receives undefined when online. Perfect gate. Verified NO game WS is opened during the entire local-game session.
home.tsx:110-133 useFocusEffect polls getSavedLocalGame first and only falls back to /api/games/current if local is null. Correct precedence.
home.tsx:164-169 chooseType('solo') pushes /game/{newLocalGameId(matchType)} without any backend call. Confirmed: no POST /api/solo request emitted when solo game starts.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable acceptance items (9/10 flows fully driven via UI; hand-end→Continuer verified via code review because 8-trick play exceeds browser-automation 120s cap — engine parity already proven by main agent's 70 simulated matches + 3000 legality fuzz + 6000 AI fuzz)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused tester1@belote.tn. Local storage key 'local_solo_game' was cleared at each test start and is correctly cleared by the quit flow. No backend games were created by the offline mode. One backend room 'EEWGSY' was created during online-regression check (leftover, harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-1 Offline AI is fully verified. Key facts to reuse: (a) starting a solo game pushes /game/local_<short|long>_<base36ts>; useLocalGame is gated by isLocalGameId(id) so useGameSocket receives undefined and NEVER opens /api/ws/game/local_*; (b) mid-game storage lives at localStorage['local_solo_game'] (web AsyncStorage) — verify with page.evaluate("localStorage.getItem('local_solo_game')"); (c) home resume-game-button pill comes from getSavedLocalGame first, then GET /api/games/current fallback — after quit, storage IS cleared but the pill may briefly show a stale backend game (spec-allowed); (d) full hand-end via UI exceeds 120s browser cap (bidding ~15-20s + 8 tricks × ~6s trick_pause + hand-end modal). Options for future E2E: add a debug fast-forward, or use the useLocalGame.send() hook programmatically via window bridge; (e) new testIDs used: play-solo-card, match-type-short, resume-game-button (already existed), quit-game-button/quit-confirm-button, pause-request-button/pause-resume-button, chat-button/chat-panel/chat-emoji-*, bidding-panel/bid-suit-{S,H,C,D}/bid-value-{90..160}/pass-button/announce-bid-button, hand-fan/hand-card-*, contract-chip, match-score-header, paused-overlay/paused-countdown, hand-end-modal/hand-continue-button. All still applicable. (f) The three console warnings (shadow*, transform-origin, Reanimated easing) are cosmetic and have been present since iter 18 — safe to ignore unless main agent wants to close them out.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only environmental limitation: exhaustive UI-driven 8-trick play + hand-end modal transition exceeds the 120s browser automation cap because of the natural 6s trick-pause and bot cadence. Engine correctness is already covered by main-agent offline parity tests.
